text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Aha! To come up with such a brilliant plan!
My own honor student brilliance terrifies me!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Combining my daily cleaning routine with workout training……
This is truly killing two birds with one stone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to figure out how to do it!
Hmm, a cleanup activity that could hone my Bakushin speed...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Not a single thing comes to mind!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you, passerby!
What do you think!? Any brilliant ideas!?
choice_data_list: Boost your speed by scrubbing the floors!
Organizing the archives builds Power too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Speed...?! You mean mopping the floors will grant me even more bakushin-speed?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What a wonderful, brilliant idea!
Let's get right to work on it immediately!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! If I tidy up at full bakushin sprint...
I can attain a truly powerful bakushin?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whooooa! Leave it to me!
Organizing and tidying up is an honor student's basic duty!

...A tremendous commotion echoed out,
but at any rate, it seems the problem was resolved.
